recommendations.idea: Verified transactional stage receipts for reader/control resume
recommendations.classification: Untested Scrolls implementation idea, source mechanism CPU-regression-tested
recommendations.change: Bind source/mesh/crop/depth planes, checkpoint and code/config hashes, stride, direction/shuffle seed, precision/TTA to one canonical signature. Reuse only after existing provenance file recheck and complete expected matched-control inventory. Stage outputs and atomically commit readiness receipt after success; preserve prior valid outputs on failure.
recommendations.avoid_duplicate: Extend existing kit.provenance helpers and wrappers instead of adding a second hash/provenance engine.
recommendations.limits: ufsm completed_prediction checks a metadata marker and matching signature, not payload hashes. Scrolls should strengthen it with existing output fingerprint rechecks; directory replacement is rollback-aware but not a power-loss-durable transaction.

recommendations.idea: Immutable planned-job inventory and explicit execution completeness
recommendations.classification: Untested Scrolls implementation idea, finite-cover control semantics CPU-regression-tested
recommendations.change: Freeze expected mesh x direction artifacts/settings before runs; record verified completed/failed/missing tasks and plan SHA. Keep planned/partial/complete execution state separate from scientific null/candidate/submission status. A resumed queue may mark completion only when every required item passes receipt verification.
recommendations.avoid_duplicate: Use ledger execution subrecord and existing preregistration; transfer finite-plan semantics to inference jobs, not ufsm training-cover code or a new trainer.
recommendations.limits: Completeness of a task inventory does not prove anatomical coverage, independent evidence or correct sheet topology. Training cursor semantics are inspiration, not validated inference portability.

recommendations.idea: Manifest-based fetch verification and bounded sparse input planning
recommendations.classification: Untested Scrolls implementation idea; current same-size-corrupt-cache gap reproduced locally
recommendations.change: Add frozen optional requested-key manifest with normalized store/key identity, metadata/version or ETag binding, byte budget, observed/expected SHA256 and atomic receipts. Recheck cached file SHA before skipping, stream bounded blocks rather than read whole objects, and optionally fetch only required CT/label keys. If later adding Range, verify Content-Range and requested byte length, distinguishing denied/error responses from genuine missing data.
recommendations.avoid_duplicate: Keep existing fetch retry and atomic replace; do not vendor ufsm HTTP/Zarr codecs.
recommendations.limits: ufsm downloader itself reuses same-size files plus saved ETag without local SHA recheck; its Zarr cache key omits store root. Do not copy those weaknesses. ETag is a version token, not universally MD5. Upstream reports bounded cold-input speedups only; no Scrolls speedup was measured.

empirical_limits: 29 CPU regressions validate their intended local synthetic cases, not whole production readiness.

Upstream README reports about1.3-1.4x whole-process cold-input gains on two native1024-cubed trials and bounded HTTP reuse gains; cached/local, GPU compute and training speedups are not established by these changes.
Upstream README explicitly describes inspected development holdouts and bounded candidate qualification, not untouched final model validation.
No models, weights, GPU kernels, training, or source code were imported into Scrolls.
